crossRefs.note: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death; for…
A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.
They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service…
“I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

parallels.note: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

people.name: Joash
people.line: The father of Gideon, a judge of Israel

translations.web: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”
translations.bsb: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son. He must die, because he has torn down Baal’s altar and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.”
translations.kjv: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove
translations.asv: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die, because he hath broken down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the Asherah that was by it.
